newsitem.title: ITALY: STET, Telecom Italia shares resume trading.
newsitem.headline: STET, Telecom Italia shares resume trading.

text.p: Shares in Italy's telecoms holding company STET and fixed-line telecoms operator Telecom Italia resumed trading on the Milan bourse after being suspended for over an hour.

During the suspension, it was announced that state industrial holding company IRI would transfer its stake in STET to the Italian Treasury for a minimum of 14.53 trillion lire, ahead of the planned merger of STET and Telecom Italia and the full privatisation of the merged group in 1997.

At 1350 GMT, STET ordinary shares were trading at 6,290 lire, up 1.86 percent on the day, after being suspended at 6,330 lire, while Telecom Italia share were trading at 3,565 lire up 3.72 percent after being suspended at 3,570 lire.
